scripts.setup: pnpm setup:api && pnpm setup:web && pnpm bootstrap
scripts.bootstrap: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/dev_bootstrap.py
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.build:web: cd apps/web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/unit
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check app tests scripts && uv run lint-imports
scripts.lint:web: cd apps/web && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
